# TALA project rules
- This is TALA, an offline Android app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, Hilt, Room + KSP, DataStore, Navigation Compose, Coroutines/StateFlow, kotlinx.serialization) for Grade 1 pupils.
- The source of truth is TALA_PROGRAMMING_GUIDE.md. Follow its build phases in order (section 8) and working rules (section 11).
- No placeholders, TODO stubs, fake-data screens, or "coming soon" buttons. Every feature must work end to end.
- Voice-first, child-safe, no-fail (no red X, no lost stars), no INTERNET permission.
- After each piece of work: build, run tests, update PROGRESS.md, log decisions in DECISIONS.md, and suggest a clear git commit message.
- If blocked, say exactly why. Never fake a feature.
